content.rendered:
Welcome back Wolves! We are so excited to be starting school next week! Our staff returned today and are already working hard to have everything ready to go for next Wednesday. 

Linked here is our first Principal’s Update for the year. We’ve included lots of information about back to school and our upcoming events. Please be sure to check it out. 

Thanks for sharing your students with us,

Miranda
